stem.text: A student wrote the following statements about the production of monoclonal antibodies.

A.text: Non-self antigen is injected into a mammal.

B.text: Plasma cells secrete the specific antibody in response to a non-self antigen.

C.text: Selected hybridoma cells divide by mitosis to form a clone.

D.text: T-lymphocytes are fused with cancer cells to form hybridoma cells.
